title: My Story
subtitle: a little at a time

story.content: Every story starts somewhere small — a hole under a tree, a door too tiny to fit through, a question that will not go away.
“Begin at the beginning, and go on till you come to the end: then stop.”
Write the opening of your own story in this chapter: where you started, and what you were curious about.
And then the ground is gone. Down, down, down — past shelves of books and lamps and jars, with plenty of time to wonder what comes next.

chapters.label: Chapter III
chapters.title: The tea party
chapters.teaser: Strange company makes the best stories.

story.content: Nothing makes sense at a tea party, and that is exactly the charm of it. The best people are the ones who pour you a cup and ask the wrong, wonderful questions.

story.caption: Friends, teammates, mentors — put their photo here.

story.content: “Why, sometimes I’ve believed as many as six impossible things before breakfast.”

chapters.label: Chapter IV
chapters.title: The garden
chapters.teaser: And the story is still being written.

story.content: Past the last door is a garden, and it is still growing. This chapter is for what you are working toward now — and an invitation for the reader to join in.
“It’s no use going back to yesterday, because I was a different person then.”
Thank you for reading this far. Leave a note on the wall before you go.
